live_test: Downloaded Real_acct_owner.zip live (211,881,907 bytes, close to the plan's ~212MB estimate); real_acct.txt (889MB uncompressed) is a real tab-delimited file with columns acct/state_class/bld_ar/new_construction_val/site_addr_1/site_addr_2/mailto exactly as named here. There is no NUM_UNITS-equivalent column in this file at all (confirmed by reading the real header row), so unlike Dallas this recipe filters class=B1 (multifamily) plus a building-area floor instead of a unit count, per the plan's 'drop small buildings by building area' instruction -- filtering state_class=='B1' (exact) and new_construction_val>0 and bld_ar>=15,000 sqft gave 89 real under-construction rows live, e.g. '23615 KINGSLAND BLVD' 396,484 sqft, $15,632,471 new-construction value. deeds.txt is a real separate file with only acct/dos/clerk_yr/clerk_id/deed_id (no owner, no price) and several dated rows per account -- joining its latest dos per account to the 2,955 real B1 accounts with bld_ar>=15,000 and filtering dos>=2024-09-01 gave 337 real sold rows live, e.g. '702 HADLEY ST' (556,114 sqft building) sold 2025-06-10 to 'RE III RESHI HOUSTON III DE LLC' -- units left as unknown since this file has no unit-count column at all.
notes: No PROPERTY_NAME-equivalent field exists in real_acct.txt either (confirmed live), so every Houston lead's name falls back to its site address, same as Phoenix's blank-name fallback from S3 and Dallas's own address fallback in this same recipe pair. `mailto` sometimes reads '% <management company> & <partner>' for multi-party LLC owners (seen live, e.g. 'ASD ALENA PROPERTY OWNER LLC &') -- kept as-is, never trimmed or guessed at, since it is the real recorded mailing name.
